answer: Make every new agent lock a refundable bond in a scarce asset, think of it as a copper deposit, then let random peer panels audit its output. Honest work recovers the stake; coordinated junk gets slashed to its nadir. One genuine agent can bloom like a lotus on a single bond, but a sybil swarm needs N separate deposits, so forging a thousand identities costs a thousand bonds plus near-certain slashing once audits spot the duplication. Expected attacker return sinks below zero while honest participation stays cheap.
